description.value: A casual bistro café in Nanaimo offering both dine-in and takeout service. Located on McCullough Road, it provides a convenient food stop for touring cyclists needing a meal break.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website successfully fetched and confirms Amore Bistro Café is an active restaurant with dine-in and takeout service. Website displays phone number (250) 585-6370 and full address; these corroborate with OSM website URL. No bike-specific amenities (parking, water refill) are mentioned on the website, so these remain null.
concerns: OSM address field empty; full address obtained from website only
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open restaurant with dine-in and takeout service. Useful food stop for touring cyclists regardless of bike-specific amenities.
